description:
Find places in India by name and get their coordinates, to use with the other Footprint tools.

Searches about 1.2 million places down to villages. Indian village names
repeat heavily (dozens of Rampurs), so each match gives its kind (city,
town, village, locality, district, state), its state and, for villages and
localities, the nearest town ("near Zaidpur"). Returns name, kind, state,
near, lat, lon for each match, best first. A pasted "lat, lon" also works.

near_lat.description: Optional: rank matches near this latitude first.
near_lat.title: Near Lat

near_lon.description: Optional: rank matches near this longitude first.
near_lon.title: Near Lon

query.description: Place name: village, locality, town, city, district or state. E.g. 'Whitefield', 'Karumuru', 'Rampur'.
query.title: Query

name: footprint_search_places
title: Find a place in India
